import json
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface
prog = currentProgram
out = {"sha256": str(prog.getExecutableSHA256())}
addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress("0x140818df0")
f = prog.getFunctionManager().getFunctionAt(addr)
if f is None:
    raise RuntimeError("function absent")
d = DecompInterface()
try:
    d.openProgram(prog)
    res = d.decompileFunction(f, 300, monitor)
    out["decompCompleted"] = bool(res.decompileCompleted())
    if not res.decompileCompleted():
        out["error"] = str(res.getErrorMessage())
    else:
        out["decompiled"] = res.getDecompiledFunction().getC()
finally:
    d.dispose()
print(json.dumps(out))
